action: Deleted the explicit public IPv4 TCP/5432 rule in the production Lighthouse firewall console after confirming the active database clients were local only. This follows the earlier UFW removal of both IPv4 and IPv6 TCP/5432 allows.
remaining: PostgreSQL still binds all interfaces at the process level; restrict it to loopback during the controlled release. Public HTTPS/443 remains closed at the cloud and host firewall layers and must be opened only for the production cutover with external TLS verification. This firewall change does not constitute deployment.
